main_text.head: APPENDIX ALIQUOT IMAGINUM ANTIQUARUM.
GULIELMUS ROVILLIUS LECTORI.
main_text.p: Hoc nostro qualicunque Iconum Promptuario ferme ad exitum perducto, oblata nobis fuerunt pauca ali-quot Illustrium virorum, qui iamdudum emicuerunt, effigies. Quas, quòd pauca admodum essent, nonnul-lis aliis, prout nobis diligenter inuestigantibus reperire licuit, augere conati sumus. Eas ergo sub finem huiusce de Iconibus Libelli, velut additamentum, Benewolentiæ tuæ offerimus. Quibus in-terea frui poteris: dum proxima editione singulas, ordine suo, ac tempore quo illustres illi viri floruerunt, inseri ac disponi, Deo auxiliante, curabimus.

page.notes: The initial H is a woodcut initial and is joined to the word "Oc" as "Hoc". The head ornament above the title and the tail-piece below the text are decorations with no printed text. The first-line text is italic throughout. The original text has "Benewolentiæ" with a w, which is kept as printed.
